headings.usage: Primary headings (H1, H2, H3). Use tracking-tight for larger sizes. Add italic variations for specific accent words (e.g., 'The Art of *Hair*').

body.usage: Body copy, button text, form inputs, small labels.

accent.usage: Used purely for the founder's signature on the About page.

buttons.primary_filled: bg-[#C9A961] text-[#050505] font-manrope font-semibold tracking-wider text-sm uppercase px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-[#DCC287] transition-colors
buttons.secondary_outlined: border border-[#C9A961] text-[#C9A961] font-manrope font-semibold tracking-wider text-sm uppercase px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-[#C9A961] hover:text-[#050505] transition-all
buttons.whatsapp_button: Uses the secondary_outlined style but includes a WhatsApp icon. Text: 'BOOK ON WHATSAPP'

section_headers.label: text-[#C9A961] font-manrope text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] mb-4 block
section_headers.title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl text-white font-playfair mb-6

cards.feature_card: bg-[#111111] border border-white/5 p-8 rounded-none transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:border-[#C9A961]/50 hover:shadow-[0_4px_30px_rgba(201,169,97,0.1)] group
cards.service_card: bg-[#111111] border border-white/5 rounded-none overflow-hidden group hover:border-[#C9A961]/50 transition-all duration-300
cards.service_card_label: text-[#C9A961] font-manrope text-xs uppercase tracking-wider mb-2

forms.input: bg-transparent border border-white/10 text-white rounded-none p-4 w-full focus:outline-none focus:border-[#C9A961] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#C9A961] transition-all placeholder:text-white/30 font-manrope

layout.hero: min-h-screen relative flex items-center pt-20. The layout MUST be split: left side contains text (50% width), right side contains the male model image filling the right half (absolute inset-y-0 right-0 w-1/2 object-cover object-center). Use a gradient overlay (from black to transparent) to blend the image into the background.
layout.spacing: Use generous vertical spacing between sections (py-24 or py-32).
layout.contact_section: Two-column bento style grid (md:grid-cols-2 gap-12). Left: 'Get In Touch' info with gold icons. Right: Booking form.

motion.hover: All interactive elements must transition smoothly (duration-300 ease-out).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for service cards and feature grids using framer-motion.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on the hero image and about page founder portrait.

icons.logo: Crossed scissors icon (Scissors from lucide-react) scaled up and styled with gold.
icons.specific_usage: Always use a thin stroke-width (1.5 or 1) for a premium, delicate look.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.anti_ai_slop: DO NOT use generic centralized layouts. Avoid default Shadcn radius. Force sharp edges (rounded-none) for a high-end editorial feel. Never use simple gray borders; use white with 5% opacity.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.transparency: DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for overlapping elements like headers or dropdowns. Always use bg-[#050505]/90 with backdrop-blur-md.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_states: Hover states must elevate elements (Y-axis translation) and introduce the brand gold (#C9A961) subtly.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.price_hiding: CRITICAL: Do not render any prices in the UI as per the owner's request.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Inject Playfair Display and Manrope via Google Fonts into the index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Setup Tailwind config to map 'font-playfair' and 'font-manrope' and the specific gold hex '#C9A961' as 'brand-gold'.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Build the custom Scissor Divider component first, as it is heavily reused.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The Hero section must exactly match the description: Text on left, massive image on right fading into the black background. Buttons must be two-tone (Solid Gold and Outlined Gold).
instructions_to_main_agent.5: No rounded corners anywhere (unless explicitly needed for an avatar). Luxury implies sharp, precise edges (rounded-none).
instructions_to_main_agent.6: In the Services Section, separate into 'Gents' and 'Ladies' tabs/grids. DO NOT show prices.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Admin Panel must have a dark mode theme matching the website but optimized for data density. Use standard Shadcn with dark/gold tweaks.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Contact Form MUST have gold focus rings: `focus:ring-[#C9A961] focus:border-[#C9A961]`.
